title: Layout build record
description: levels/<slug>/builds/revision_<n>.json: what generate_layouts built for revision n -- the brief it was asked, every layout with its evidence, and the automated recommendation (packages/service/layouts.py).

brief.description: The level_factory.mission_brief.v0.1 the pipeline was given.

recommended.description: A candidate_id; when every_out is true it is the one that failed least, not a recommendation.

recommendation.description: What the ranking weighed, as shown. Since Level Factory 0.251.0.

plan_key.description: The key to the plans' colours. Since Level Factory 0.250.0.

not_counted.description: Findings shown but not counted (advisory, or answered by the walk test).

out_for.description: Why the layout is out; empty when it is not.

grade.description: Laser Tag's grade, or ? when there is no report.

walked.description: The walk test walked every leg.

plan.description: The layout's top-down plan (SVG), or null. Since Level Factory 0.250.0.
